title: Stale BG number on Always On Display
body:
The BG number that shows on the Always On Display will often be stale.  In attached images, the current BG is 158.  Always On Display shows 144, which is from 15 minutes prior.  I've seen it show a much older reading in the past few days.
![20180912_202121](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/20321279/45460243-46117b80-b6ca-11e8-91c3-df7e964b3bdf.jpg)
![20180912_202039](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/20321279/45460244-46117b80-b6ca-11e8-97d0-ef4a705b103f.jpg)

xDrip+ Version 1809080944
LG G6
Android 8.0.0

comments.body: I think this might be the always on display caching the data. If you unlock the phone does the notification area instantly have the correct number icon?

It is the same for me on a LG V30 (Oreo 8.0.0). Even if I unlock the screen and open Xdrip, the AOD stays on the same outdated value.  Please, can you check this?
NOTE: In the notification area on top of the phone I have enabled in xdrip to show the number of the current BG. This is working fine. The issue is only in the AOD.
Did you find a solution to this? Same thing happening with my LG V40
Same issue on my LG G6

@bassettb I am closing this issue as you never responded to the question posted by a developer.
We can always re-open if needed.
